pendingApplications.proposal: Non material amendment to approved application DM2024/00888 which allowed the variation of condition 1 (Approved Plans) of planning permission Ref: DM2020/00217 for the 'Partial demolition of existing buildings, involving the retention of the front facade onto the High Street, and erection of a part 3, part 4 storey building comprising retail (Class E) on the ground floor and 10 dwellings on the upper floors with associated cycle parking and refuse storage to allow alterations to facade and parapets' to allow the removal of the railings at green roof level and install a man safe maintenance access system.

pendingApplications.proposal: Non material amendment to approved application DM2024/01476 which allowed the ''S73 Application to vary conditions 1 (Approved Drawings), 3 (Building Storey Heights), 4 (Number of Homes), 6 (Cycle Spaces), 7 (Car Parking) and 43 (Play Space Provision) of planning permission ref: DM2022/01764 for the 'Site clearance and the phased development of new buildings containing residential uses, Class E commercial uses and sui generis uses (inc. drinking establishments including those with expanded food provision), private and communal amenity space, car parking, cycle parking, and other associated works. (THIS APPLICATION INCLUDES AN ENVIRONMENTAL STATEMENT)'' to provide alterations to the footprint of Blocks B and D, alterations to the fenestration, along with internal reconfiguration to provide an additional 21 homes.

Non material amendment to approved application DM2023/01511 which allowed the ''Demolition of existing dwelling and erection of a detached two storey building with accommodation in the roof space comprising 16 units in connection with the use of the property as a supported living care home, altered vehicular and pedestrian access to/from Mollison Drive and Stafford Road , provision of vehicular parking, erection of a detached single storey cycle store, integrated refuse store to the rear of the building, associated hard and soft landscaping, provision of amenity areas and provision of new boundary treatments.'' to allow for internal alterations and removal of the elevator.

Application to vary condition 12 of planning permission DM2023/01511 for the ''Demolition of existing dwelling and erection of a detached two storey building with accommodation in the roof space comprising 16 units in connection with the use of the property as a supported living care home, altered vehicular and pedestrian access to/from Mollison Drive and Stafford Road , provision of vehicular parking, erection of a detached single storey cycle store, integrated refuse store to the rear of the building, associated hard and soft landscaping, provision of amenity areas and provision of new boundary treatments.'' to allow for alterations to the ventilation method.

Demolition of single storey rear extension, erection of two bay windows to front elevation, conversion of garage into habitable room, erection of front boundary wall, alterations to existing render, raised patio to rear and boundary treatment in connection with conversion of property from 2 self contained flats into 2 dwellinghouses.
